mechanism: pure detached interpolation evidence, transfer admission, representation provenance
assumed_input_authority: Existing issued endpoint and site helpers plus explicit finite scalar kind. Real K2 owns syntax, parent and actual scalar-type proof.

fixed_example.source_and_target_context: same full declaration and execution proof, call stack, predicates

new_facts: NONE. No NonNull or representation identity follows from interpolation.

rows.selector: ValueStringDerivationOracleTest.entry index accepts zero and maximum Int but rejects negative input
rows.expected: index0 and Int.MAX_VALUE admitted, negative rejected

rows.selector: ValueStringDerivationOracleTest.each admitted scalar kind keeps its exact template entry and index
rows.expected: all nine scalar kinds preserve exact templateRange, entryRange, entryIndex and scalarKind

rows.selector: ValueStringDerivationOracleTest.whole LocalRead scalar derives the exact whole template with all state
rows.expected: LocalRead Whole to exact template ExpressionResult Whole preserves source, target, execution, stack and predicates

rows.selector: ValueStringDerivationOracleTest.whole expression scalar also derives the template
rows.expected: ExpressionResult Whole scalar admits same template

rows.selector: ValueStringDerivationOracleTest.entry must lie strictly inside the template
rows.expected: entry equal to template, either shared delimiter, or outside template rejects

rows.selector: ValueStringDerivationOracleTest.direct evidence cannot assert a derivation
rows.expected: Direct evidence rejects DERIVATION

rows.selector: ValueStringDerivationOracleTest.interpolation evidence cannot assert an ordinary transfer kind
rows.expected: StringInterpolation evidence rejects every ordinary transfer kind

rows.selector: ValueStringDerivationOracleTest.another template or an input outside the exact entry cannot borrow interpolation evidence
rows.expected: different template or input outside exact entry rejects

rows.selector: ValueStringDerivationOracleTest.another entry in the same template cannot borrow the scalar occurrence
rows.expected: another entry and index in same template cannot admit original scalar occurrence

rows.selector: ValueStringDerivationOracleTest.a field path and non-scalar source role cannot become a whole template
rows.expected: source or target nested field path and invalid source or target role reject

rows.selector: ValueStringDerivationContextOracleTest.a different declaration cannot receive the same range as a string derivation
rows.expected: different declaration rejects with all other target state preserved

rows.selector: ValueStringDerivationContextOracleTest.a changed scope with identical declaration metadata cannot receive the derivation
rows.expected: changed source scope with same declaration identity and range rejects

rows.selector: ValueStringDerivationContextOracleTest.a different anonymous body under the same host cannot receive the derivation
rows.expected: different anonymous body under same host rejects

rows.selector: ValueStringDerivationContextOracleTest.a fresh basis cannot receive an older interpolation transfer
rows.expected: foreign basis rejects with BASIS_MISMATCH

rows.selector: ValueStringDerivationContextOracleTest.a missing frame or another same-callee invocation cannot receive the derivation
rows.expected: missing frame or another invocation of same callee rejects

rows.selector: ValueStringDerivationContextOracleTest.derivation cannot erase a predicate or invent an unrelated predicate
rows.expected: removed or unrelated added predicate rejects

rows.selector: RepresentationStringDerivationOracleTest.string derivation weakens known representation and keeps the exact compiler transfer history
rows.expected: Known becomes Unknown(UNMODELED_TRANSFORMATION), exact CompilerTransfer history appended and target state preserved

rows.selector: RepresentationStringDerivationOracleTest.string derivation preserves a preexisting unknown reason
rows.expected: preexisting Unknown(INPUT_STATE_NOT_ESTABLISHED) reason survives, exact history appended

rows.selector: RepresentationStringDerivationOracleTest.interpolation stays compiler history and never becomes a reviewed representation application
rows.expected: interpolation remains CompilerTransfer history and creates no Model history

rows.selector: RepresentationStringDerivationOracleTest.another scalar occurrence cannot borrow the origin representation for derivation
rows.expected: another scalar source occurrence rejects representation propagation with SITE_MISMATCH
